abstract: BACKGROUND: Pure testicular choriocarcinoma is a rare type of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor extremely poor prognostic with the tendency to bleed at the metastatic site. At the time of the diagnosis, 70% of patients have metastatic lesions. Depending on the site of the metastasis, symptoms vary. Gastrointestinal involvement is seen in less than 5% of cases, mostly in the duodenum. CASE PRESENTATION: We present a 47 years old male with testicular choriocarcinoma involving the jejunum, lung, liver, and kidney presenting with acute abdominal pain, melena, and dyspnea with some paraneoplastic symptoms. The patient had increased, severe and constant pain in the right lower quadrant for the previous four days. Additionally, he was complaining of nausea, vomiting, anorexia, and a history of melena for the last 10 days. Dyspnea on exertion, hemoptysis, and dry cough were the symptoms he was suffering from, for almost one year. The patient's general appearance was pale, ill, and thin with 10 kg of weight loss during the last some months. The computed tomography (CT) scan reported multiple metastatic lesions in both liver lobes and the left kidney. Pathologic study of the samples of small bowel lesions showed metastatic choriocarcinoma. Following the patient had been referred to an oncologist to start the chemotherapy regime. Finally, the patient has expired after 40 days of his first admission. CONCLUSIONS: Testicular choriocarcinoma is a rare but fatal malignancy among young men. Gastrointestinal metastases are infrequent involvement represented by melena and acute abdominal pain, obstruction, and mass. Physicians should consider it as a differential diagnosis for acute abdomen and gastrointestinal bleeding causation.
abstract_ja: 背景：純粋型精巣絨毛癌は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の稀な型であり、予後は極めて不良で、転移部位で出血しやすい傾向がある。診断時点で患者の70%に転移病変が認められる。転移部位によって症状は異なる。消化管への浸潤は5%未満の症例に見られ、多くは十二指腸に生じる。症例提示：空腸、肺、肝臓、腎臓に浸潤した精巣絨毛癌を有する47歳男性が、急性腹痛、黒色便(タール便)、呼吸困難および若干の傍腫瘍症状を呈して来院した。患者は4日間続く右下腹部の増強・持続性の強い痛みを訴えた。さらに、10日間にわたる悪心、嘔吐、食欲不振、黒色便の既往があった。運動時呼吸困難、喀血、乾性咳嗽は約1年間続いていた。患者の全身状態は蒼白で、病み衰えた様子であり、数か月間で10kgの体重減少があった。CTでは両側肝葉および左腎に多発転移病変が報告された。小腸病変の病理検査では転移性絨毛癌が示された。その後、化学療法のため腫瘍内科に紹介された。患者は初回入院から40日後に死亡した。結論：精巣絨毛癌は若年男性に発生する稀だが致死的な悪性腫瘍である。消化管転移は稀な浸潤形式であり、黒色便、急性腹痛、閉塞、腫瘤として現れる。医師は急性腹症や消化管出血の原因の鑑別診断として本疾患を考慮すべきである。
